name: Laura Gómez
description: Laura is a passionate teacher with over 10 years of experience in web technologies education. Her approach combines theory and practice, and she strives to motivate her students to develop logical thinking and applicable technical skills.

name: Carlos Méndez
description: Carlos has dedicated his career to teaching intermediate and advanced mathematics. He is known for his ability to explain complex concepts in a simple way and his commitment to progressive learning.

name: Ana Torres
description: Ana specializes in natural sciences and has worked with high school students for over 8 years. Her teaching method is based on observation, experimentation, and project-based learning.

name: Miguel Ángel Pérez
description: Miguel Ángel is passionate about world history. His goal is to help students understand the present through the analysis of past events, using maps, documentaries, and class discussions.

name: Valentina Ruiz
description: Valentina combines her art knowledge with contemporary pedagogy. She firmly believes that creativity should be encouraged from an early age and has developed innovative programs in visual arts and creative expression.

name: Fernando Delgado
description: Fernando has worked in various institutions as a physics teacher. He is passionate about sparking scientific curiosity in young people and helping them understand how the world around them works.

name: Sofía Herrera
description: Sofía is an English teacher with international certifications. She has taught in bilingual academies and focuses on developing oral and written communication skills naturally.

name: Daniela Pacheco
description: Daniela specializes in programming and backend development. In addition to teaching, she has worked as a developer in tech startups, allowing her to share real-world experiences with her students.

name: José Ramírez
description: José has been part of educational teams focused on physical education and health. He promotes an active lifestyle and teaches training techniques, nutrition, and overall well-being.
